n: Common Sense Facing Off with Facial Recognition lesson
t: A 20 minute discussion lesson on the benefits and risks of facial recognition.
steps: Find the Facing Off with Facial Recognition lesson on the Common Sense Education site.
Sign in with a free teacher account.
Print the student handout if you want paper copies.
Project the slides to introduce the vocabulary.
Present the lunch-line scenario and ask students to pick a side.
Close with a short talk on what students would want the school to decide.
